verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission crew consists of four astronauts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the astronauts — commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, mission specialist Christina Koch and Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen" (R1); "The crew is completed by his compatriots Victor Glover and Christina Koch, as well as Canadian Jeremy Hansen" (R2); consistently lists four across all.
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state the crew has four astronauts.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission crew is scheduled for a flyby of the Moon in 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Launch April 1, 2026... loop around it (R1); launch scheduled for April 1... trajectory to the moon (R2); Artemis II mission around the Moon (R3); trajectory... around the moon (R4); launched April 1, 2026... lunar flyby (R5).
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm launch and flyby in 2026.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission crew will be the first to travel around the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first piloted moonshot since the end of the Apollo program 53 years ago" (R1); "return of crewed flights around the moon after more than half a century" (R2); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972" (R5).
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm first since Apollo era, over 50 years (1972-2026=54).

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman is the NASA Commander for the Artemis II mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "commander Reid Wiseman" (R1,R3); "mission will be commanded by US astronaut Reid Wiseman" (R2); "Artemis II mission is commanded by NASA astronaut Reid Wiseman" (R4).
verifications.reasoning: All sources identify Wiseman as commander.

verifications.reasoning: Most sources describe as 10-day; R1 says 9.5, R5 9 days+, but commonly accepted as 10-day.
